aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: After being mistakenly arrested and identified as France's most wanted fugitive, a peaceful retiree finds his quiet life thrown into chaos as he fights to clear his name against a relentless media circus.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In this French comedy-drama directed by Gérard Jugnot, peaceful retiree Serge Martin is mistakenly arrested and confused with France's most wanted criminal. Overnight, he becomes the focal point of a massive media frenzy, social media hysteria, and administrative incompetence. As 24-hour news networks jump to conclusions, Serge must navigate absurd legal obstacles and public outrage to prove his identity. Ultimately, he fights a hilarious yet poignant battle to clear his name and reclaim his quiet life.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Serge Martin is an unassuming retiree whose ordinary life revolves around his hometown community and his local historical association. His peaceful routine is abruptly shattered when police mistakenly arrest him, believing him to be the notorious fugitive at the top of France's most-wanted list. Before the authorities can verify his identity, news of his arrest leaks to the public, igniting a viral sensation across social media and continuous news channels. Sensationalist journalists and ambitious media personalities quickly paint Serge as a criminal mastermind, completely ignoring his desperate pleas of innocence. Trapped within a bloated and clumsy bureaucratic judicial system, Serge finds himself defending his reputation while dealing with misguided prison encounters, opportunistic politicians, and intrusive reporters. Surrounded by a colorful group of friends, townspeople, and eccentric legal figures, he embarks on a chaotic quest to unravel the mix-up. As public opinion shifts unpredictably with every televised broadcast, Serge uses his simple wit and determination to outsmart the sensationalist media machine. Through a series of escalating blunders and absurd miscommunications, he gradually exposes the flaws of immediate digital journalism while striving to recover his normal, quiet existence.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Inspired by real-life mistaken identity cases, Mauvaise Pioche follows Serge Martin, a quiet and mild-mannered French retiree whose life is turned upside down in an instant. Due to a bizarre administrative blunder and a striking visual resemblance, Serge is arrested under the assumption that he is France's most notorious fugitive. Before law enforcement can conduct proper background checks or DNA verification, rolling 24-hour news networks pick up the story and broadcast his face nationwide, instantly making him a national spectacle. As media pundits analyze his life and internet users fuel wild conspiracy theories, Serge finds himself stranded inside a legal system that moves too slowly to correct its own glaring mistake. Accompanied by a quirky group of allies—including well-meaning local friends and bewildered law enforcement officials—Serge must confront the absurdities of sensationalist journalism and viral internet fame. The film delivers a sharp yet lighthearted satirical look at modern news cycles, administrative rush to judgment, and the overwhelming power of public opinion, while tracking one ordinary man's humorous quest to reclaim his identity and peace of mind.
